sentences.display: In nineteen thirty-two, Harry St John Philby went in search of Wabār, deep in the Rubʿ al-Khālī.
sentences.tts: In nineteen thirty-two, Harry Sinjun Philby went in search of Wabaar, deep in the Rub al Khaali.

sentences.display: Bedouin had told him of ruins, and of a block of iron the size of a camel.
sentences.tts: Bedouin had told him of ruins, and of a block of iron the size of a camel.

sentences.display: After a month of hard travel, he reached a field of black glass and craters half choked with sand.
sentences.tts: After a month of hard travel, he reached a field of black glass and craters half choked with sand.

sentences.display: He thought it was a volcano.
sentences.tts: He thought it was a volcano.
